expedite.reason: Riley's soccer season has started and the orthopedist wants therapy to begin next week.

statements.text: The emergency doctor at Cindervale asked me to get an abdominal ultrasound within a month, and Quillmont had the only opening near home before the month ran out. I did not know it was out of network. Please cover it at the in-network level.
The discharge papers from the Cindervale emergency department, dated December 31, ask for the ultrasound within a month. The first in-network appointment I was offered was in late February.

info_requests.text: The referral from the doctor who ordered the ultrasound

statements.text: Jordan cut his hand repairing the garden fence at home on a Monday evening; it did not happen at work. The accident answers were entered as work related by mistake. Please process the visit and the repair.

Riley's sixth approved therapy session was moved from October 8 to October 13 because the clinic closed for a staff training day; the authorization still had that session left. Please cover it as part of the approved course.
